Infinzi (durvalumab) in the perioperative setting in combination with Pfizer
Padcev (enfortumab vedotin) for muscle-invasive bladder cancer patients who are ineligible for cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
Approval was based on results from the phase 3 VOLGA trial that showed significant improvements in event-free survival and overall survival in patients on the combo vs. those on standard care.
The combo reduced the risk of death by 42% compared to the standard of care arm.
The new indication is also under review by regulators in the European Union, Japan, and several other countries.

title: AstraZeneca gains additional bladder cancer indication for Imfinzi
